Plate of the Prime Apex
4 Taurachni Edged Tarsus, 6 Jhotus Osteoderms Plate, 1 Nuthorghull Skull Plate, 
12 Maedrynn Iridescent Feathers, 1 Slannethiss Paddle Fin
Supplies: 4
The mark of true dominance of Sol'Kesh, this fortress of armor embodies the strengths from 
the apex creatures that rule their biomes with natural ferocity and cunning.
The True Apex Advantage on Wisdom (Animal Handling), Charisma (Intimidation) 
and Taming checks (pg. 251).
Quill Spines When you are Grappling a creature, or being Grappled, the enemy 
creature suffers 7 (2d6) Piercing damage at the beginning of your turn.
Indomitable You count as one size larger when determining whether you can be 
Shoved, Grappled, or knocked Prone.
Streamlined Form Your swim Speed is increased by 10 ft..
Brute Predator When you move at least 20 ft., in a straight line toward a creature 
and then hit it with a melee attack roll, you can force the creature to make a 
Strength Saving Throw DC 10 + the ability modifier used to make the attack roll and 
your Proficiency Bonus. Failure: The creature has the Prone condition.

1 Tormull Fermented Nectar and 8 Abdomen Spikes, 12 Herragath Lilyscales
Lilypin [42.]
Alchemist's Supplies
Common
Supplies: 1
1/2 Day Focused
Floating amongst other lily pads, the readied mine can trigger with but the gentlest of waves.
With a Utilize Action you can place the Lilypin upon a calm water surface, it will 
activate within 1 minute as the Lilyscales soak.   
Lilyburst Trigger: When a creature touches it or disturbs the water around it in 
within 5 ft. Response - Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 20 ft. Sphere 
centered on the Lilypin trap. Failure: 10 (3d6) Piercing damage and the creature 
has spikes impaled in their flesh. Impaled creatures take 3 (1d6) Piercing damage 
at the beginning of their turns until the spikes are a removed, all spikes can be 
removed with a single successful DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check or a DC 16 
Strength check.
Detecting DC 16 Wisdom (Perception) check to notice the Lilypin trap if it is 
hidden amongst Fenlands or equivalent aquatic plants. If it is not surrounded by 
similarly looking plants, or none at all, it has a DC 8 Wisdom (Perception) check to 
ascertain whether it is a natural plant or not.  
Disarming A creature must first approach the Lilypin without disturbing the water 
by performing a DC 12 Dexterity (Slight of Hand) check to pick it up. Success: The 
Lilypin trap is disarmed and can be re-used. Failure: The trap explodes as if triggered.

Pacifist Pins [41.]
Weaver's Tools
Common
Supplies: 1
1/4 Day Focused
The slight pinprick of pain is quickly replaced by a curiously numbing calmness and peace.
With a Utilize action you can spread the Pacifist Pins on the ground to cover a 5 
ft. square area.  
Peaceful Pinning Trigger: Any creature that moves into the area. Response - 
Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature within the 5 ft. square space. Failure: 
The creature immediately stops moving and takes 2 (1d4) Piercing damage as the 
pins are embedded into the creature. Impaled creatures take 1 Piercing damage 
at the beginning of their turns, have their walking speed reduced by 10 ft. and has 
Disadvantage on Initiative and Intimidation rolls until the pins are a removed. All 
pins can be removed with a single successful DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check or 
a DC 14 Strength check.
DC
12

1 Baughur Chambered Stomach and 1 Congealed Blubber, 6 Bloomux Bloomspines
Pyrefoot Mine [40.]
Alchemist's Supplies
Common
Supplies: 1
1/2 Day Focused
Hunting is not always a stealthy affair, and sometimes explosives are needed.
With a Utilize Action you can plant the Pyrefoot Mine into the ground, activating 
it by gently pushing the pressure plate until a click is heard. Triggering the 
Pyrefoot Mine explodes when a creature steps on it or disturbs it.  
Pyre Fire Trigger: When creature steps on the mine. Response - Dexterity Saving 
Throw: DC 15, the creature that triggered the mine. Failure: 14 (4d6) Fire damage 
and catches fire, causing an additional 3 (1d6) Fire damage at the start of the each 
of its turns for 1 minute. A creature can use an Action to extinguish the flames on 
themselves or to help an another, ending the ongoing damage on a successful DC 
11 Dexterity check.
Detecting DC 16 Wisdom (Perception) check to notice the buried mine.  
Disarming A creature can use an Action to disarm the Mine with a successful DC 
16 Dexterity check using Thieves' Tools by separating the pressure plate. Success: 
The Pyrefoot mine is disarmed and can be re-used. Failure: The mine explodes as 
if triggered.
DC
13

Rarity

1 Mollucite Viscid Fluid, 1 Glomunder Paralytic Tendril, 1 Scorpithine Scorpithi Toxin
Paralytic Mucilage 
Alchemist's Supplies
Common
Supplies: 1
1/2 Day Focused
1 Day Patient
Apply carefully, too many Travelers have been found lying unresponsive next to their own trap.
6 Uses - Applying this mucilage to any surface with a Utilization Action and lasts 
for 1 day, it dries invisibly within 1 minute and covers a 1 ft. by 1 ft. square. 
Numbing Salve Trigger: When a creature comes into contact with the mucilage. 
Response - Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, the creature in contact. Failure: Target 
has the Paralyzed condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, 
ending the effect on itself on a success. After 3 minutes, it succeeds automatically.
DC

Rarity

2 Skyelarx Hooked Claw, 8 Mollucite Glassy Shard Teeth, 1 Cerrophol Hollowed Mantle
Glassmaw Pit
Tinker Tools
Common
Supplies: 1
1/4 Day Focused
The greatest trappers know how to put what nature has evolved to deadly use.
With a Utilization Action, bury the Glassmaw Pit into the ground, lightly covering 
the ring of teeth with soil.  
Glass Grip Trigger: When a Medium or smaller creature steps upon the 
Glassmaw Pit trap. Response - Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, the creature that 
triggered the trap. Failure: 10 (3d6) Piercing damage and the target has the 
Prone and Restrained condition (escape DC 12) as their limb falls into the 
spiked cavity. When extracting their limb from the trap, the backwards facing 
teeth cut into their flesh, causing 10 (3d6) Slashing damage upon removal. 
Detecting DC 14 Wisdom (Perception) check to notice the Glassmaw Pit trap if it 
is hidden under the dirt by some glassy teeth shining through.  
Disarming A creature must first approach the Glassmaw Pit without disturbing 
it and performing a DC 14 Dexterity check to dig and pick it up. Success: The 
Glassmaw Pit trap is disarmed and can be re-used. Failure: The trap closes tightly 
and cannot be used again.
DC

Rarity
Crafting Time
1 Jhotus Optic Parasite, 1 Korrask Feeler Tendril, 1 Scorpithine Stiletto Leg
Weald Watcher
Tinker Tools
Rare
Supplies: 1
1 Day Focused
Parasites only ever look for a creature to settle upon, and the Jhotus optic parasite's natural 
reaction, paired with a thin bladed limb makes for a surprisingly effective reactive guard.
With a Utilization Action, place the Weald Ward on the ground, it will activate 
when the leg is pressed down and clicks. By spending 10 minutes near the Weald 
Ward trap, the parasite becomes accustom to your presence and won't trigger 
towards you.  
Stalking Eye Trigger: When a creature approaches within a 30 ft. Sphere centered 
on the trap. Response - Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17, the creature that triggered 
the trap. Failure: 4 (1d8) Poison damage and has the Poisoned condition. The 
creature can repeat the save at the end each of its turns, ending the effect on 
itself on a success. While Poisoned, the creature slowly becomes paralyzed, after 1 
minute the poison sets in the target creature has the Paralyzed condition for 1 hour. 
Detecting DC 14 Wisdom (Perception) check to notice the Weald Ward trap to see 
its questing parasite eye.  
Disarming A creature must first approach the Weald Ward slowly with a DC 17 
Dexterity (Stealth) check to pick it up. Success: The Weald Ward trap is disarmed 
and can be re-used. Failure: The trap reacts as if triggered.
DC

Petal Attar [43.]
Alchemist Supplies
Common
Supplies: 1
1 Day Focused
Beasts of all sizes flock to the alluring scent, sometimes more than the Traveler bargained for.
Luring Scent 12 Uses - You may Utilize the Lure by painting a 1 ft. by 1 ft. square 
on a dry surface. The liquid then draws the attention of all Beasts within a 300 ft. 
radius for 30 minutes. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14, beasts within a 30 ft. Sphere 
originated on the painted square. Failure: Target creature has Disadvantage 
against Perception checks for the duration of the Lure.  
DC
9

Rarity
Crafting Time
2 Icullus Spindly Pincer, 1 Fungus Laced Blood Vial
Grave Stepper
Tinker Tools
Common
Supplies: 1
1/4 Day Focused
Minuscule by design, the small pincer trap can cause unseen, long lasting pain. 
With a Utilization Action, place the Grave Stepper in the ground, it will activate 
when the pincers are pushed back and click in place.  
Deathly Pinch Trigger: When a creature steps upon the Grave Stepper trap. 
Response - Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, the creature that triggered the trap. 
Failure: 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage and has the Poisoned condition. While Poisoned, 
the creature reduces its maximum Hit Points by the amount equal to the Necrotic 
damage taken. The creature can repeat the save at the end each of its turns, 
ending the effect on itself on a success, or end it successfully after a Long Rest. 
Detecting DC 16 Wisdom (Perception) check to notice the Grave Stepper trap if it 
is hidden under the dirt by the two pincer prongs.  
Disarming A creature must first approach the Grave Stepper without disturbing 
it and performing a DC 12 Dexterity check to dig and pick it up. Success: The Grave 
Stepper trap is disarmed and can be re-used. Failure: The trap snaps forward 
dealing damage as if triggered.
Arguslate [39.]
18 Argustaur Slate Scales, 12 Korruk Dermal Plates
Supplies: 4
Heavy as an unmoving stone, the plate armor allows the wielder to weather a storm of blows.
Shelled Stance You can use your Bonus Action to hunker down and gain a +3 
bonus to your Armor Class, but this lowers your movement speed by 10 ft. until 
you use another Bonus Action to leave this stance. 
Earthen Plate In the Farplains or equivalent arid environments, if you remain 
motionless, you do not suffer Disadvantage from Stealth checks while wearing 
this armor and instead gain Advantage on Stealth checks as you blend into the 
arid surroundings. This advantage is lost if you move or take any action other than 
maintaining your stillness.

Brutal Solguard
2 Khanith Savage Mandible, 1 Daugon Solar Sail, 16 Grahknash Sandstone Scales
Supplies: 3
Brutal and unyielding like the sun, the Solguard armor deals more damage than it receives.
Solar Sail Absorption Whenever you take Fire damage, you reduce that damage 
by 1d6 to a minimum of 1.  
Scaled Bash You can use your Action to do an unarmed Strike and shove a Medium 
or smaller creature within 5 ft.. On Hit: The target takes 1d6 Slashing damage + your 
Strength modifier and must succeed on a Strength Saving Throw DC = 8 + Strength 
modification + proficiency. Failure: Target creature is shoved directly away 5 ft..

Tainted Mulch
Leatherworker's Tools
Rare
Supplies: 3
1 Day Focused
Mixing the worst of the digestive juices with the jade eye of a Lexati produces an aggressive 
growth serum that makes any plant or fungus dangerously poisonous. 
Virulent Growth With a Utilize Action, you can spread the fertilizer liquid across 
a 5 ft. by 5 ft. square on any given plant or fungal growth. The clear liquid then 
turns the flora poisonous to the touch for 7 days, without harming the flora as it 
ingests the toxins.
Toxic Touch Trigger: When a creature moves through or comes in contact with 
the flora within the Tainted Mulch's poisoned space. Response - Constitution Saving 
Throw: DC 17, the creature that triggered the trap. Failure: 18 (4d8) Poison damage 
and has the Poisoned condition. The creature can repeat the save at the end each 
of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 10 minutes, it succeeds 
automatically. While poisoned, the target suffers a hacking cough and has 
Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and suffers one level of Exhaustion.
